landing_page.title: AI ke saath prabhavit resumes banayein
landing_page.description: MultiCV aapko har naukri ke liye vyaktigat resumes generate karne mein madad karta hai. Yeh takneekik professionals ke liye ek tezi se aur elegant AI-powered anubhav ke liye bana hai.

features.title: Aap MultiCV ke saath kya kar sakte hain?

first.title: Smart Assistant
first.description: Apne anubhav, uplabdhiyaan, aur skills ko spasht, akarshak, aur optimized tarike se likhne mein madad lein.

second.title: Multiple CVs
second.description: Alag alag companies, industries, ya technical roles ke liye apne resume ke alag alag versions manage karein.

third.title: Instant Adaptation
third.description: Ek click mein naukri ke liye specific resumes swachalit roop se generate karein.

vision.title: MultiCV ka Bhavishya
vision.description: Sochiye ek aise duniya ka jahan aapko resume banane ki bhi zarurat nahi hai. Hamara mission logon aur companies ko seedha jodna hai, AI ka istemal karke aapka profile sanrachit karna, aapki taakat ko ubharna, aur anya filters ko khatam karna.
vision.start_now: Main bhavishya ka hissa banna chahta hoon

cta.title: AI ke saath apna resume banana shuru karein
cta.description: Hamare beta phase ka hissa banein aur MultiCV ko shape dene mein madad karein. AI ke saath samajhdar resumes banana shuru karein aur apne naukri ki talash mein aage badhein.
